name: explicit-binary-io
objective: Complete the documented filesystem binary-I/O obligation. Provide a maintained BinaryCodec in the codecs package, exported by both the codecs package and the filesystem public root, using the existing BinaryFile model. Generic read must support an explicit FileFormat.BINARY override with exact arbitrary bytes and existing byte limits; generic write must serialize BinaryFile via the codec and the existing atomic writer, preserving fsync/replacement, permission normalization, overwrite policy and cleanup. Retain immutable model metadata. Binary is explicit-only: do not infer binary from any suffix or change existing text/JSON/Markdown/CSV inference or behavior. Integrate with static codec resolution, typing and public exports; no registry or new I/O framework. Do not change tests or acceptance.
oracle:
import importlib,tempfile,os
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
from devtools.core.paths import ResolvedPath
from devtools.resources.filesystem import BinaryFile,FileFormat,FileFormatError,FileTooLargeError,read,write
public=importlib.import_module('devtools.resources.filesystem')
codecs=importlib.import_module('devtools.resources.filesystem.codecs')
assert hasattr(public,'BinaryCodec'),'Missing public BinaryCodec'
codec=public.BinaryCodec()
assert codecs.BinaryCodec is public.BinaryCodec
assert importlib.import_module('devtools.resources.filesystem.codecs.binary').BinaryCodec is public.BinaryCodec
assert 'BinaryCodec' in public.__all__ and 'BinaryCodec' in codecs.__all__
from devtools.resources.filesystem.resolution import resolve_codec,resolve_file_format
assert isinstance(resolve_codec(FileFormat.BINARY),public.BinaryCodec)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
 root=Path(folder)
 for n,content in enumerate((b'',b'\x00\xff\xfe\n\r',bytes(range(256))*8)):
  path=ResolvedPath(root/f'data-{n}.unknown')
  model=codec.decode(path,content)
  assert type(model) is BinaryFile and model.path==path and model.content==content
  assert model.size_bytes==len(content) and not model.truncated
  assert codec.encode(model)==content
  write(model)
  assert path.value.read_bytes()==content
  loaded=read(path,file_format=FileFormat.BINARY,max_bytes=len(content))
  assert type(loaded) is BinaryFile and loaded.content==content and not loaded.truncated
  assert read(path,file_format=FileFormat.BINARY,max_bytes=None).content==content
  if content:
   try:read(path,file_format=FileFormat.BINARY,max_bytes=len(content)-1)
   except FileTooLargeError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('Binary read bypasses byte limit')
  try:read(path)
  except FileFormatError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('Unknown suffix must still fail inference')
  try:write(BinaryFile(path,b'changed'),overwrite=False)
  except FileExistsError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('Overwrite refusal missing')
  assert path.value.read_bytes()==content
 for suffix in ('.bin','.unknown'):
  try:resolve_file_format(ResolvedPath(root/('probe'+suffix)))
  except FileFormatError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('Binary inference was not authorized')
 target=ResolvedPath(root/'atomic.dat'); target.value.write_bytes(b'old')
 events=[]; fsync=os.fsync; replace=os.replace
 def synced(fd): events.append('fsync'); return fsync(fd)
 def replaced(src,dst):
  assert Path(src).parent==Path(dst).parent
  events.append('replace'); return replace(src,dst)
 with patch('devtools.resources.filesystem.writing.os.fsync',side_effect=synced),patch('devtools.resources.filesystem.writing.os.replace',side_effect=replaced):
  write(BinaryFile(target,b'new'))
 assert events==['fsync','replace'] and target.value.read_bytes()==b'new'
 with patch('devtools.resources.filesystem.writing.os.replace',side_effect=PermissionError):
  from devtools.resources.filesystem import FilesystemPermissionError
  try:write(BinaryFile(target,b'never'))
  except FilesystemPermissionError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('Permission contract changed')
 assert target.value.read_bytes()==b'new' and not list(root.glob('.atomic.dat.*.tmp'))
print('QWEN_BEHAVIOR_PASSED binary codec, bounded read, atomic write, exports, explicit-only policy')
